scientific_integrity: The full frozen-order stability and optimal-rate classification is proved analytically. The stochastic counterexample has a positive-definite rational quadratic form certificate. Finite verification checks support only the specified finite identities. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two centered one-dimensional strongly convex quadratic components, unreset per-component heavy-ball momentum, constant learning rate and exact arithmetic. The conclusion is an expected-square divergence, not almost-sure divergence; the source literature cannot exhaust all periodic-coefficient and switching-systems prior art.
title: Reentrant cyclic heavy-ball stability and a reshuffling-induced mean-square explosion
